requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify the new model family and relevant official Suno capability information
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 0 requires current official Suno capability verification before model-dependent advice and records models, native duration, editing capabilities, controls, and relevant rights rules.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: mark model-dependent historical heuristics as requiring revalidation
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 9 explicitly marks older model-dependent learnings revalidation_required when the Suno model changes.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve user preferences that are independent of the model
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The learning loop explicitly separates user preference from model behavior, so workflow preferences such as avoiding cumbersome Extend remain scoped independently from model performance.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: run a limited fresh comparison before promoting the old length or prompt heuristic to the new model
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow requires fresh evidence after model-family changes and the Explore -> Select -> Refine loop provides the controlled comparison mechanism before cross-project promotion.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy old model limits into the new capability snapshot without verification
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Phase 0 states that historical model limits are not current facts and requires official current verification.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: discard historical learning instead of retaining it with scoped validity
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The learning contract retains historical observations and marks model-dependent ones for revalidation rather than deleting or rewriting them.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: confuse user taste with model behavior
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Phase 9 defines separate classes for user preference, project observation, model behavior, and cross-project learning.
